mechanism: Persistent observed boundary contradiction; no increased trust from losing a boundary.
hypothesis: The exact clear subsets differ because one-side fitting releases a prior two-side disagreement cap, adding a gauge vote at raw frame152. Preserving contradictory evidence until a valid two-side agreement should prevent that false STOP without suppressing supported positives.

fixed_variant.state: Detector-owned optional axis contradiction cap, initially absent; not part of fitter geometry feedback.
fixed_variant.observation: Record current fresh two-boundary curvature disagreement on TrackModel; None for fewer than two fitted boundaries or failed floor fit. A returned previous geometry is not fresh agreement. Update trust once per processed frame after mount calibration and its final fit/rotation. A large correction uses only the final corrected-frame fit; a small rotation preserves the observation from that frame.
fixed_variant.enter: With walls_enabled and axis_sides_max_disagreement>0, fresh finite two-boundary disagreement>axis_sides_max_disagreement sets cap=min(current raw axis_valid, axis_disagree_range, previous cap if active).
fixed_variant.hold: Without a fresh two-boundary agreement, an active cap becomes min(previous cap, current raw axis_valid); it cannot increase, including after one/no boundary, floor-fit failure, mount reseed, tracker reseed or input gap. Input gaps preserve this state only until an explicit Detector.reset; the node can treat some gaps as scene resets, which release it by the reset contract.
fixed_variant.release: A fresh finite two-boundary disagreement<=axis_sides_max_disagreement clears the cap. Equality is agreement, as in baseline. Detector.reset/new Detector also clears it; mount correction or tracker reset alone never clears it.
fixed_variant.disabled: If walls are disabled or axis_sides_max_disagreement<=0, this mechanism is inactive and its state is absent, matching the disabled disagreement rule.
fixed_variant.application: Keep TrackModel.axis_valid raw so floor, rail, calibration and next-frame geometry fitting are unchanged. Apply min(raw axis_valid, cap if active, gauge.range_max) to the corridor trusted axis range; existing downstream cluster, low-stage, hanging and health paths receive it without additional changes.
fixed_variant.telemetry: When cap active, serialize axis_valid as the effective min, and add axis_observed_range and axis_contradiction_cap. Raw model attribute remains unchanged for fitter. No change to geometry fields or monitoring health policy beyond inherited range effects. axis_observed_range names the raw fitter estimate and does not imply fresh physical observation. Final corridor limits can additionally narrow the serialized axis bound via gauge/floor/no-rail/both-side rules.
fixed_variant.constants: All configuration values unchanged, including existing disagreement6.7e-4, disagreement range60m, one-side range120m. No object-distance, shape, column, voxel, association or axis-union changes.
scope: resense/track.py: fresh observation metadata and active-cap serialization only
resense/detector.py: state/reset, final-fit update, corridor cap, inaccurate comment corrections
fixed_variant.comments: Correct remaining verified-clear/fail-safe claims to estimated monitored range with misses possible. M2 already corrected FrameResult, _clear_cap and HealthMonitor module text; do not duplicate or alter behavior.

validation.premeasurement: Commit this exact protocol, then source and fixed original72 plan receipt; independent review by quality_second_judge before any candidate replay.
unit: tightening is monotone until fresh agreement
new/reset clears but calibration small rotation and large reseed alone do not
fitter geometry and raw range not mutated by trust cap
effective telemetry agrees with corridor range

target_screen.inputs: The exact zero-based header subsets from the retained clear-failure receipt: failed233, historicalstock243, historicalpass234. Raw CDR sequence and source arrays unchanged.
target_screen.required: All three subsets have zero STOP frames; former passing subset remains zero. Candidate geometry fields must equal corresponding M2 replay (excluding additive/effective axis trust metadata). Report all advisory/range changes; no retry replacement.

validation.fullgate: If target screen passes, unchanged regression_gate.py against frozen and M2 references, every available row (currently199 comparisons,146 gated), no worsening gated rows, missing rows or waivers. Full positive/outside/empty/ride and SetF coverage required.
validation.novel: All original72 cases retained, same inputs/cases/config/evaluator. New plan copies exact parent plan, changes ONLY candidate source receipt plus parent-plan hash. No per-case matched-frame loss, no per-shape total loss, no lost whole case, no increase in paired control alarms.
validation.coverage: Every empty recording and each ride segment: frame-aligned new CAUTION<=5 percentage points and median estimated range>=0.95 of M2 AND original frozen baseline. Report monitored range and clear-distance estimate separately. No suppressing reports or always-CAUTION acceptance.
validation.stress: If all earlier gates pass, --every2, +3deg roll, +3deg pitch on six recordings and start offsets0/10/20/30/40 on six, unchanged positive/false-positive score rows against archived references; report range cost with available evidence limits.
validation.raw: If earlier gates pass, raw SetO vs archived raw, retaining raw/cache differences, no positive or outside regression.
validation.runtime: Only after offline acceptance and root coordination: idle p95 decode+detect<=100ms and zero post-settle unprocessed frames; the strict zero-alarm clear trial remains separately required and failed prior trial retained.
validation.reject: One fixed variant only. Any target, positive, false-positive, coverage, stress or novel acceptance failure rejects T1 without tuning or threshold variants. Retain exact source and all complete/partial results; no integration or new freeze merely because an aggregate improves.
validation.claim_limit: A trust-consistency/false-alarm correction does not demonstrate broad object recall improvement, untouched real holdout validity, or meeting the separate two-family/two-background detection target.

release: Remains held; root owns integration and final acceptance.
review_clarifications: Before measurement, independent reviewer requested explicit gap/reset semantics and fresh-fit tests for final calibration reseed. No variant or thresholds changed.
